interpretation: Supported child-like resting pose: sit toward the heels, fold and reach the forehead and central palms to the floor. Two-second entry, one-second hold and two-second return demonstrate the movement; the catalogue workout recommendation remains30–60seconds. Exact stance, timing, scapula-complex motion and local hip-volume component are authored.

correctives.drive: Quintic smootherstep of measured bilateral hip flexion above the native first-fold onset; exactly0 at neutral and1 at supported peak.
correctives.original_weights: Exact original whole-body weights; no inherited binding or old inverse-LBS feather.
